items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: Like Ray Wetzel was the disciplinarian of the group.

ctx.x: Oh, that's right, we were talking about John Howell, and that's how it came up.

Yeah. The '49 band, the trumpet section was Johnny Howell, Ray Wetzel, Maynard Ferguson, Doc Severinsen and Ralph Ericson. And it was something to hear, that trumpet section. They all made a contribution. Like Ray Wetzel was the disciplinarian of the group. I mean he'd say do it like this. And they respected Ray, believe me. This included Maynard and they respected his generalship. Of course Maynard had his thing and Doc had his thing and Ralph had his thing,
and then Johnny had his thing, but they respected Ray, and Ray ran -- actually was the general. And they did some remarkable things. I know Harry James came into Bop City and heard them and --
